FAQ

Selling surplus plastic film rolls

What plastic film rolls do you buy?

We're most interested in single resin, unlaminated rolls: PP, BOPP, OPP, PET, LDPE, HDPE, LLDPE, PVC, PS and nylon. We also buy multilayer laminates, coated films, heat shrink and Cryovac, pouch and lidding films, and metallized film.

Do you buy metallized, holographic or hot stamping film?

Yes. We buy vacuum deposit and metallized film, holographic film and hot stamping foil, printed or unprinted, laminated or coated.

Which industries do your film rolls come from?

We buy rolls from flexible packaging converters, laminators and slitters, metallizers, food and beverage packers (lids, pouches and bags), pharmaceutical packagers (blister lidding and pouch), and health and beauty brands using high-barrier and shrink films.

Do you buy laminated or printed film?

Yes. Single resin film is our main interest, but we also buy surplus rolls of many laminate films, printed and unprinted. Send us the structure and we'll let you know.

How do I sell my surplus film rolls?

Tell us the resin or structure, gauge and width if you know them, the gross weight on hand and your pick-up location. Add photos, and as your roll buyer we'll send you a proposal.

How fast can you pick up?

We buy rolls in full and partial trailer loads across North America, usually with a truck at your warehouse within 48 to 72 hours.
